planner_json.why_required: GAW-6 cannot run: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.0.4 declares engines node >=22.19.0 and jobs.smoke has no setup-node step, so it runs whatever Node the runner image ships. GAW-3's status and verify cannot run: Codex's sandbox on Ubuntu 24.04 fails with bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR: Operation not permitted until the AppArmor user-namespace restriction is lifted (openai/codex-action does this on hosted Linux runners).
implementation_steps: Add `actions/setup-node@v4` with `node-version` 24 and no `cache` input to `jobs.smoke`, after checkout and before the install slot. [PRIMARY]

Add one keyless step, `if: matrix.harness == 'codex'`, before the install slot, that runs `sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0` when the current value is not 0. It holds no secret and no env entry.
Run FLOW-GRD-06-MISSING-KEY to confirm no credential moved onto a keyless step.
Run FLOW-RUN-02-HAND to confirm the smoke job still has no cache step and no secret on an install step.
verification_checklist: node --test --test-name-pattern 'FLOW-GRD-06-MISSING-KEY' tests/sprint-01/grd-06-missing-key.test.mjs exits 0: no credential moved onto a keyless step.
node --test --test-name-pattern 'FLOW-RUN-02-HAND' tests/sprint-01/run-02-hand.test.mjs exits 0: the job list and declaration rules still hold.
On a dispatched run, the codex cells' load evidence shows codex sandbox linux /bin/true exiting 0, and both pi cells read an observed_cli_version.
